subject: Another Road Rash?
author: Segaswirl
body:
Any chance of a next gen Road Rash? I think Criterion is probably the best studio for the job seeing as you're part of EA now... and you have made a bike game before. I'm sure i've got a copy of Suzuki Alstare Extreme Racing for the Dreamcast sitting around here somewhere with Criterion's name on it 😛

It could be very similar to Burnout... instead of takedowns and cars you have people on bikes beating the shit out of each other with chains and spraying mace in each others eyes... in full HD👍

 

Another Strike game from EA would also not go a miss.

subject: the music...
author: alexward
body:
Earlier in the year we found all of the files for B1, B2 and the 'lost' B3 soundtrack so we decided as we have the space on the disc to put ALL of into the game.

The actual naming of the game came from a nod to the title of a GnR album. We're excited that we got to put the song into the game. For a long time during the year, it was up in the air as to whether it would happen or not.

It actually came down to Mr. A. Rose giving approval to use the track. And he was away overseas on tour for a long time.

But it all worked out in the end.

I'm quite surprised that no-one has picked up on the addition of 'Rusty Cage' by Soundgarden going in there. That's just a nod to one of MY favourite 3DO games, 'Road Rash.'

I'll never forget the first time that disc booted up at home. I've still got my Panasonic machine and it goes at least once a year. I borrowed money off my girlfriend at the time to buy the machine so desperately did I want it.. And I used to read the early issues of EDGE religiously as it was the only magazine that was covering the early 3DO 'scene'.

Total Eclipse, Off World Interceptor, Shockwave (still a good intro), Dragon's Lair - bought them all at fifty quid a pop.

Oh, the memories.
